correctness.rationale: The independent replay /workspace/branches/9a66e3f9-5c10-4c44-ac0d-9b512d0a36d8/independent_census.py with independent_census_output.txt enumerated every labeled edge mask at orders one through seven, filtered connected graphs and tested each nonempty induced subset for connectivity and domination. Upward closure makes the differential the one-vertex extension matrix; exact F_2 ranks give c_k-r_k-r_(k-1). The independent connected counts (1,1,4,38,728,26704,1866256), zero Euler counts (0,0,3,34,660,24401,1691767), and joint counts (0,0,0,0,0,0,252) agree with the frozen checks/bold_census_output.txt. Each positive has mod-two Betti numbers one in degrees two and three only, with two nonadjacent apices joined to a 2-regular five-vertex rim, necessarily C_5. Its automorphism group has size 20, so 7!/20=252. For the integral assertion, the downward-closed non-connected-dominating complex consists of the apex edge and the rim complex whose five triangles collapse across the five free perimeter edges, leaving the diagonal cycle. The relative cochain model with the full simplex has the stated one-degree cardinality shift, and the relative long exact sequence gives another shift to reduced cohomology of this disjoint union. This yields Z in bold degrees two and three and nowhere else. The original checker was inspected, not executed; the global census is only over F_2 and n<=7.
